subject: Vendor activation prerequisites & PO flow — Greenline Health integration
messages:
From: Susan Frost <susan.frost@greenlinehealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenlinehealth.com
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor activation prerequisites & PO workflow for Redwood integration

Hi Neha,

Following our recent conversations with Marissa, Greenline is preparing the purchase order for the Redwood integration (we expect an initial pilot scope). Before we can route the PO through our finance system, procurement is asking for a short set of activation artifacts from your side so we can complete the vendor setup in our ERP.

Can you confirm whether you can provide the following items and an estimated delivery date?
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (redacted if needed) or SOC 2 summary
- ISO 27001 certificate (if held)
- Penetration test attestation / letter of no critical findings
- Completed supplier onboarding forms (tax W-9 / local equivalent, bank details, contact info)
- Copy of standard PO terms and instructions for invoicing (PO routing steps, remittance address)

We have a target to issue a PO by next Thursday, so if some docs need to be put into a secure link that’s fine — we just need an approximate timeline. I attached our RFI to show the procurement fields.

Thanks — happy to set a quick call if easier.

Susan Frost
Head of Procurement, Greenline Health
Susan.Frost@greenlinehealth.com
Attachment: Greenline-RFI.pdf (application/pdf)
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Susan Frost <susan.frost@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor activation prerequisites & PO workflow for Redwood integration

Hi Susan — thanks for the note and the RFI. Welcome — we’re excited to partner with Greenline.

Quick answers and proposed next steps below:

1) Docs we can provide this week:
   - SOC 2 Type II: we can provide a redacted PDF plus a short summary (expected deliverable: redacted SOC2 summary PDF)
   - ISO 27001: we hold ISO certification; will share certificate scan.
   - Pen test attestation: our most recent third-party pen test letter (attestation of scope & no critical findings).

2) Supplier onboarding forms / PO flow
   - I attached our supplier onboarding checklist (fillable PDF) that covers bank details, tax, contacts, and required signoffs. Please route that back to procurement.
   - For PO routing: our preferred path is consolidated billing via Accounts Payable in San Francisco — instructions and remittance details are in the PO-instructions doc (attached).

3) Timeline
   - We can deliver the security artifacts (SOC2 redacted, ISO cert, pen-test attestation) by Wednesday EOD (2027-05-05) if you confirm preferred transfer method (secure link, encrypted email, or a signed NDA first).
   - Supplier form and bank details: we can complete or validate fields within 1 business day once you confirm the contact.

Next steps (suggested):
- Susan: confirm whether you need the full SOC 2 or a redacted version and whether procurement requires a signed NDA for redacted artifacts.
- Marissa (cc’d): please review and add any commercial/PO notes.

If it helps, we can do a 20-minute call Wednesday morning to walk procurement through the artifacts.

Best,

Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-supplier-onboarding-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Susan Frost <susan.frost@greenlinehealth.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor activation prerequisites & PO workflow for Redwood integration

Hi Susan — copying the commercial side so we’re aligned on timing and invoicing. A few clarifications from our end: 

- Deal & billing: This is the pilot SOW under GLH-2027-78945. We typically accept POs referencing the deal id; invoices should reference the PO number and our remit info.
- PO generation: Once procurement confirms vendor setup is complete in your ERP, please route PO to billing@redwood.com. We process weekly on Fridays.
- Terms: Standard 45-day net on pilot invoices (can discuss if finance requires 30-day).

Action items for procurement:
- Confirm whether the vendor creation requires a company bank verification form (some ERPs require a bank letter from the bank) — if so, advise and we’ll coordinate with our treasury team.
- If you prefer DocuSign for the PO signature path, share the link; otherwise we can accept a scanned signed PO from procurement.

I’m available for a short sync Thursday to confirm PO issuance timing.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: PO-instructions.pdf (application/pdf)
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 5 May 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor activation prerequisites & PO workflow for Redwood integration — security artifacts

Marissa / Neha — adding security context for procurement.

We can provide the following artifacts and notes to satisfy most ERP procurement gates:
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted PDF) + single-page SOC2 control summary. Note: full report available under NDA or secure transfer.
- ISO 27001 certificate (scan) + scope statement.
- Pen test attestation letter signed by our third-party vendor (no critical findings in the latest engagement).
- A short security questionnaire template (if they want to map controls to SOC2/ISO claims).

Security caveats and recommended handling:
- Redacted SOC 2 is fine for procurement intake; if legal requests deeper review we’ll open access via a secure portal.
- For bank verification / treasury forms: we do not include bank account numbers in public artifacts. Treasury will provide a bank-letter PDF signed by the bank upon request.

I’ll prepare the artifacts and upload them to a secure link by end-of-day Wednesday (2027-05-05). Please confirm if Greenline requires the artifacts to be delivered to a specific procurement mailbox or uploaded into a vendor onboarding portal.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-summary.pdf (application/pdf); ISO27001-certificate.pdf (application/pdf); pen-test-attestation.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Susan Frost <susan.frost@greenlinehealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenlinehealth.com, po@greenlinehealth.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor activation prerequisites & PO workflow for Redwood integration

Neha / Marissa — thank you, this is very clear. Procurement confirms we can accept redacted SOC2 and the other artifacts via a secure upload. We do not require an NDA for the redacted copies.

Our PO team completed vendor creation today and assigned PO #78945. I attached the draft PO for your review and requested timeline to process the first invoice is 45 days per the PO. Please confirm you accept the PO terms and that billing@redwood.com is the correct remit address.

Attachments: Greenline-PO-78945.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Susan Frost
Head of Procurement, Greenline Health
